# Functional Requirements

Status: draft

## FR-1: Galaxy Map

The game shall present a galaxy containing at least 8 named star systems, each with a station where the player can dock.

## FR-2: Commodity Market

Each station shall offer a commodity market displaying goods with per-system price variation. The player shall be able to buy and sell commodities, limited by available credits and cargo capacity.

## FR-3: Hyperspace Jumps

The player shall be able to initiate hyperspace jumps between star systems. Each jump shall consume fuel proportional to distance. The player shall be unable to jump if insufficient fuel is available.

## FR-4: Pirate Encounters

Each hyperspace jump shall carry a risk of pirate encounter. When a pirate is encountered, the player shall enter combat or be given the option to flee.

## FR-5: Ship-to-Ship Combat

The game shall provide arcade laser combat between the player's ship and enemy ships with AI-controlled behavior. Combat shall resolve in victory (enemy destroyed), defeat (player ship destroyed), or escape.

## FR-6: Ship Upgrades

The player shall be able to purchase ship upgrades at stations: cargo capacity, laser power, shields, and fuel tank size. Upgrades shall be paid for with credits.

## FR-7: Elite Rating System

The game shall track the player's rating based on accumulated profit and combat kills, progressing through rating tiers toward the Elite rank.

## FR-8: Save and Load

The player shall be able to save the current game state and load a previously saved game state to resume play.

## FR-9: Health Check Endpoint

The server shall expose a `/healthz` endpoint that returns a success response indicating the server is operational.

## FR-10: Starting Conditions

A new game shall start with the player docked at a station, possessing 100 credits and a small cargo hold.

## FR-11: Visual Effects

The game shall render a parallax starfield, hyperspace jump effect, station docking screen, ship HUD (shields, fuel, cargo, credits), and laser combat visual effects.
